key_themes.shadow_axis: Rahu-Ketu-Ketu combination represents the most critical juncture - complete spiritual death or rebirth
key_themes.maximum_obsession: Rahu-Rahu-Rahu represents maximum illusion, obsession, and deception at peak
key_themes.guru_chandal: Rahu-Jupiter combinations activate complex guru-student wisdom-desire dynamics
key_themes.emotional_shadow: Rahu-Moon combinations intensify emotional illusions and psychological patterns
key_themes.karmic_tests: Rahu-Saturn combinations present severe karmic lessons and limitation tests

summary.general_guidance: Rahu Mahadasha is about material expansion through desire, foreign ventures, technology, and unconventional pursuits. The shadow is obsession, deception, and illusion. Success requires awareness of obsessive patterns and conscious use of intelligence without deception. Spiritual practice and reality-testing essential to avoid complete entrapment in illusions.
remedies_overall: Honesty and transparency in all dealings
